assets.name: geology-overview
assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: finished raster illustration for a Chinese petroleum geology teaching website. Style: polished isometric miniature 3D educational diorama, warm ivory paper background #fff8ed, detailed physically plausible equipment, soft ambient shadows, orange-suited geologists, muted sandstone, sage and teal, matching the attractive mud-logging process miniature aesthetic. No browser chrome, no UI cards, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. Leave breathing room around subjects. This is an explanatory illustration, not a statistical plot. Landscape 3:2 high resolution. Main request: one coherent regional geological survey landscape divided into four distinct connected work areas. Upper left: satellite above rugged bare stratified hills, showing multispectral remote sensing, aerial terrain and a folded sandstone outcrop. Upper right: geologists collect a grid of soil samples with labelled-looking blank vials (no actual writing), a small geochemical mobile laboratory with colored test tubes and sampling tray. Lower left: archival geological paper map with differently colored strata, a large scanning device, workstation tracing colored geological map lines and annotations as tiny unreadable strokes. Lower right: geologist with tripod camera and small drone studying fracture networks in a vertical limestone outcrop, ruler and survey targets. All four flow through subtle colored ribbons to a small integrated regional geology map table at bottom center. The main geological setting is land surface investigation; do not show oil drilling rigs, wells, pumpjacks or underground oil lakes. Balanced spacious quadrants separated by pale empty paths. Rich visual detail, well-organized composition.

assets.name: g4-outcrop-fractures
assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: finished raster illustration for a Chinese petroleum geology teaching website. Style: polished isometric miniature 3D educational diorama, warm ivory paper background #fff8ed, detailed physically plausible equipment, soft ambient shadows, orange-suited geologists, muted sandstone, sage and teal, matching the attractive mud-logging process miniature aesthetic. No browser chrome, no UI cards, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. Leave breathing room around subjects. This is an explanatory illustration, not a statistical plot. Landscape 3:2 high resolution. Main request: measuring visible rock outcrop fractures, a scientifically careful three-station left-to-right scene. Left: large vertical exposed layered limestone cliff with two dominant joint sets and some bedding lines, tripod camera pointing perpendicular at the rock, geologist holding a meter survey staff with black-white blocks. Center: floating flat photograph of the same cliff, visible dark fracture traces highlighted with thin teal and orange strokes, little branches and discontinuities retained; faint skeletonized lines in a second translucent plane. Right: geologist at a field laptop reviewing line segments and a neat circular direction diagram as graphical object without numeric values; a sample tape and compass on the table. The output is orientation and trace length within the image plane, never claim 3D geological attitude from a single uncalibrated photograph. Shallow outcrop stage base, ivory background, cool sage and orange color notes. No drilling machinery.
